unspecified_visual_details: The angel's appearance, the setting, and how the nations and kingdoms are visually represented.

title: The great church
summary: Nephi sees the formation of a great church among the nations of the Gentiles. The angel describes the church and its treatment of the saints of God. Nephi beholds the church and sees that the devil is its founder.
characters: The angel who appeared to Nephi
locations: Among the nations of the Gentiles in Nephi's vision

explicit_facts.text: Nephi sees the formation of a great church among the nations of the Gentiles.
The angel describes the church as slaying, torturing, binding, and bringing the saints of God into captivity.
Nephi beholds the great and abominable church and sees that the devil is its founder.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Nephi observes the church in a vision while the angel speaks to him.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance of the church, the angel, and the devil.
How the church's formation is shown in the vision.

spoken_dialogue.text: Behold the formation of a church which is most abominable above all other churches, which slayeth the saints of God, yea, and tortureth them and bindeth them down, and yoketh them with a yoke of iron, and bringeth them down into captivity.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: The angel who appeared to Nephi

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The angel describes the church's treatment of the saints; the verses do not say Nephi witnesses those acts taking place.
prohibited_inventions: Do not identify the church with a named historical institution.

unspecified_visual_details: The people, designs, or surroundings associated with the goods and the church's actions.
